review.reason: The project is a library and a command-line program. It has no web interface for a browser-driving review to exercise.

always: the five gates: both pytest markers, ruff check, ruff format --check, mypy --strict
test-driven development, with the failing case stated in the verdict
the register invariant: the key count of tests/foxio_deviations.json equals the xfailed count
heavyProofOnlyWhen: a change can move a fingerprint
a change alters a published output field or the output schema
a FoxIO reading or a divergence register entry is at stake
heavyProofMeans: mutation reversal proofs, with the mutation proven live and discriminating in both directions
byte-identical replay of every committed capture
verificationDepth.note: Epics 7, 8 and 9 are database enrichment, documentation and packaging. No fingerprint moves in them, so the heavy proof is not mandatory. The project manager applies it where conformance is actually at stake, and a worker may always apply more than the floor.

docsMcp.note: No documentation MCP server is connected and no concrete marketplace source exists in this repository. Workers read vendor documentation with WebFetch, which .claude/rules/external-apis.md requires.

notes: .github/workflows/test.yml triggers on push and on pull_request for branches [master, dev]. A batch pull request into dev starts a run, so provider continuous integration is the batch gate.
publish.yml triggers on a published release only, so a merge to dev deploys nothing. Stage D is skipped.

Worktree policy from session 6. The harness owns every worktree. The project manager launches a worker with isolation "worktree" and never calls EnterWorktree. A worker never calls EnterWorktree or ExitWorktree either, because that pin is session-scoped and every live agent shares it. The project manager stays in the repository root and names an absolute path on every git command.

The system Python holds no scapy and no cryptography. A worker builds a virtual environment before it runs any gate. .venv/ and venv/ are ignored from session 6, so the environment may live in the worktree.

Verification is tiered from 2026-08-08. The floor binds every issue; the heavy proof binds only conformance-affecting work. The heavy discipline found a real defect on nearly every issue of Epics 4 to 6, including two tautological assertions inside tests a worker had just written, so it is dialled back rather than dropped.
